answer: Each epoch opens one narrow inlet of 100 entry slots. A newcomer bids a walnut bond of 60 credits for a slot, locked 20 epochs; top 100 win, losers refunded. Every bid enters a public crystal ledger, so one actor taking many slots shows as one cluster. Forging 1,000 identities means 1,000 × 60 = 60,000 locked against a 40,000 pool, a net loss; rented bids cost 60 each and cluster too. An honest agent pays 60 once and keeps its slot and share.
